name: entangling rope
desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=n8nEah4vbrEPphNF]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=n8nEah4vbrEPphNF]] feet.
